entries.zh: 那套玩具火车绕着一座小纸板车站行驶。

entries.meaningZh: 无法投递也无法退回的邮件
entries.en: The postal exhibit explains how dead mail is handled.
entries.zh: 邮政展览说明了如何处理无法投递也无法退回的邮件。

entries.en: The soldiers withdrew behind a smoke screen.
entries.zh: 士兵们在烟幕掩护下撤退。

entries.en: The collection plate passed quietly along the pew.
entries.zh: 奉献盘沿着教堂长椅静静传递。

entries.en: Surface noise was audible between songs on the old record.
entries.zh: 旧唱片的歌曲间隙能听到摩擦噪声。

entries.en: The diagram highlights the right brain in pale blue.
entries.zh: 示意图用浅蓝色标出了右脑。
